Accordingly, the Director has constituted the following Course Equivalence and Credit Transfer Committee:

Dr. Manish Narwaria, Associate Professor, Deptt. of EE

A copy of Grade /GPA Equivalence Policy is attached Annexure- A

Terms of Reference:

1. The Course Equivalence Committee will oversee if the courses done at the previous/ visiting academic
Institute can be considered as equivalent to any approved course in JIT Jodhpur by considering different
factors that the committee find deems fit (for instance, credit definition, credit structure, contact hours, course
content, nunlber of lectures, laboratory components etc.) on a case-to-case basis.

2. The Committee will make the recommendations for the approval of the Chairman, Senate.

Frequency of meeting: - As and when required

Tenure: 1st September 2024 to 31st August 2025
